lines.en: label amimaid30:
scene amimaidthirty1
I arrive at the maid cafe bright and early to see how Ami’s doing.
lines.zh: 我一早赶到女仆咖啡厅,想看看 Ami 干得怎么样。

lines.en: : Wow! You’re here bright and early!
lines.zh: : 哇!你来得可真早!

lines.en: See?
lines.zh: 看到没?

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty2
: Did you wind up skipping the breakfast I made for you this morning or something?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是错过了我今天早上做的早餐什么的吧?

lines.en: : You made me breakfast this morning?
lines.zh: : 你今天早上给我做了早餐?

lines.en: : Yeah, I wrapped it up and left it on the table for you.
lines.zh: : 对啊,我包好放在桌上了。

lines.en: : I didn’t really have time to write a note or anything because I was running late for work, but I figured you’d have just...understood that it was there for you and not somebody else.
lines.zh: : 我赶着上班,没来得及写张便签什么的,不过我想你看到就会……明白那是留给你的,不是留给别人的。

lines.en: : Honestly, I didn’t even notice.
lines.zh: : 说实话,我根本没注意到。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty3
: Oh well! I’ll just assume that since you’re here, it meant you missed me so much that you ran right over as soon as you woke up!
lines.zh: : 好吧!那我就当你是因为太想我,一起床就飞奔过来了!

lines.en: : Yeah, let’s go with that.
lines.zh: : 对,就这么理解。

lines.en: : Is Uta-chan working now?
lines.zh: : Uta 酱现在在班上吗?

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty4
: Or you only came here to toy with my feelings!
lines.zh: : 还是你来这儿就是为了玩弄我的感情!

lines.en: : Am I not good enough for you all of a sudden? Why Uta-chan and not your beloved [niece]?
lines.zh: : 我怎么突然不够好了?为什么是 Uta 酱,而不是你心爱的 [niece]?

lines.en: : Because Uta-chan would never put on a face like that while she’s at work.
lines.zh: : 因为 Uta 酱上班的时候,绝不会摆出你刚才那副表情。

lines.en: : And here I was thinking you were finally beginning to get the hang of your new job...
lines.zh: : 我还以为你终于开始上手新工作了呢……

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty5
: I am getting the hang of my new job! I’m really good at this!
lines.zh: : 我上手了!我干这个可拿手了!

lines.en: : Great. Then you can start chipping in on bills soon. The one for our phones has been getting pretty high lately.
lines.zh: : 那很好。那你很快就能开始分担账单了。最近我们的话费单有点高。

lines.en: Though, there is a very good reason for that.
lines.zh: 当然,这背后有非常正当的理由。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty6
: What? How? I thought we had unlimited data and all that stuff?
lines.zh: : 什么?怎么会?我们不是无限流量什么的吗?

lines.en: : Long story. Point is, now that I know you have a stable job that you’re doing well at, it’s time to start growing up financially as well.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。总之,既然我知道你有了一份干得不错的稳定工作,你也该在财务上长大了。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty7
: Ooooooooor you can keep paying all the bills and I can use the money I make at work to do all sorts of fun things with you.
lines.zh: : 咚咚咚,要么你继续付所有账单,我用上班挣的钱跟你做各种好玩的事。

lines.en: : Or to you, depending on the mood we’re in.
lines.zh: : 或者在你身上做,看我们当时的心情。

lines.en: : I am both intrigued and scared at the same time now.
lines.zh: : 我现在同时被勾起了兴趣和恐惧。

lines.en: : I guess there’s no harm in letting you use your money how you please.
lines.zh: : 由你支配自己的钱,应该也没什么坏处。

lines.en: : I’m a little surprised you don’t want to spend it on yourself, though. Wasn’t that the whole reason you got a job in the first place?
lines.zh: : 不过你不打算花在自己身上,倒让我有点意外。你当初找工作不就是为了这个?

lines.en: : Kind of. It’s been an interesting change of pace and I’d be lying if I said I wouldn’t rather spend my time pleasing you and you only-
lines.zh: : 算是吧。这段节奏变化挺有意思的,要我说谎的话,我当然更想把时间全花在取悦你一个人身上——

lines.en: : But being able to buy clothes is nice too.
lines.zh: : 但能自己买衣服也很不错。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty1
: And so I was kinda wondering if you’d wanna maybe come to the mall with me soon and...help me pick out a new swimsuit for the next time we go to the beach.
lines.zh: : 所以我就在想,你要不要近期陪我去趟商场……帮我挑一件新泳衣,下次去海滩穿。

lines.en: : Ami, it’s the middle of winter.
lines.zh: : Ami,现在是大冬天。

lines.en: : So what? Even if it’s freezing cold out when we go to the ocean, we’re still going to wind up swimming.
lines.zh: : 那又怎样?就算去海边的时候冻成狗,我们最后反正会下水。

lines.en: : What’s the point of having a vacation at the beach if you’re not going to go swimming?
lines.zh: : 去海滩度假不下水,那还有什么意义?

lines.en: : Plus, the swimsuit I have now is really...childish anyway.
lines.zh: : 再说了,我现在这件泳衣真的很……幼稚。

lines.en: : And if I’m gonna start doing grown-up stuff like working and living at the dorm, I’m gonna need to look the part.
lines.zh: : 既然我要开始过大人生活——上班、住宿舍——那我也得有大人该有的样子。

lines.en: : The days of the one piece are over, Sensei! The days of bikini Ami are about to begin!
lines.zh: : 连体泳衣的时代结束了,Sensei!比基尼 Ami 的时代即将开启!

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re going to be able to find one that...you know...fits?
lines.zh: : 你确定你能找到一件……你懂的……合身的?

lines.en: : Because I think the one piece might actually be a better bet until you...grow in a little more.
lines.zh: : 因为我觉得,在你再……发育一点之前,连体款可能才是更稳妥的选择。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty8
: Hey, is there anything I can be doing to help out while there are no customers here? I feel weird just standing around.
lines.zh: : 喂,没有客人的时候,有没有什么我能帮忙的?干站着感觉好怪。

lines.en: : I’m a customer.
lines.zh: : 我是客人。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty9
: Please don’t look at me.
lines.zh: : 请不要看着我。

lines.en: : Also, did you say something mean to Ami? She looks kinda...frozen.
lines.zh: : 另外,你是不是对 Ami 说了什么难听的话?她看起来有点……冻住了。

lines.en: : How am I supposed to talk to you if I’m not allowed to look at you?
lines.zh: : 不让我看着你,我怎么跟你说话?

lines.en: : Just look the other way or something, I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 那就看看别的地方之类的,我也不知道。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty10
: Hah...
: Even those would be a gift from God right now.
lines.zh: : 连那种东西现在都算上帝的恩赐了。

lines.en: : Think, Osako.
lines.zh: : 想啊,Osako。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty11
: You didn't say what I think you did to her...did you?
lines.zh: : 你没有对我做你刚才暗示的那种事……对吧?

lines.en: : You can just hang out, Osako-chan...I don’t really know what to do when it’s dead either.
lines.zh: : Osako 酱随便坐坐就好……店里没人的时候,我也不知道该干嘛。

lines.en: : And no one ever really comes until the afternoon anyway...
lines.zh: : 反正下午之前,基本也不会有客人来……

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty12
: Okay...sounds good, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好……那听起来不错,大概。

lines.en: : And, uhh...hang in there? Mine didn’t start showing up until senior year of [high_school] and...
lines.zh: : 还有,呃……加油?我的那个直到 [high_school] 高三才来……

lines.en: : Why am I even telling you this? I’m just going to go...re-wash dishes or something.
lines.zh: : 我为什么要跟你说这个?我去……把洗过的碗再洗一遍好了。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty13
Osako leaves the table and I suddenly have to figure out a way to make Ami feel better.
lines.zh: Osako 离开了餐桌,我突然得想办法哄好 Ami。

lines.en: Thankfully, this is the easiest possible task that could ever fall into my lap.
lines.zh: 所幸,这是我此生可能接手的最简单的任务。

lines.en: : I love you and you’re adorable.
lines.zh: : 我爱你,而且你很可爱。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty14
: Ah! I love you too!
lines.zh: : 啊!我也爱你!

lines.en: : What were we just talking about? Did Osako-chan need help with something?
lines.zh: : 我们刚才在聊什么来着?Osako 酱需要帮忙吗?

lines.en: : Nah, she’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 没事,她自己会好的。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty14
: Shit!
lines.zh: : 糟了!

lines.en: : See?
lines.zh: : 你看吧。

lines.en: : Oh well. Uta drops stuff all the time so we can just add it to the list. Our manager is really forgiving about that kind of stuff.
lines.zh: : 唉,没事。Uta 也老摔东西,记到那张清单上就行。店长对这种事特别宽容。

lines.en: : Well that’s reassuring. Having a manager that gets on your case all the time doesn’t sound like a thing I’d be able to handle.
lines.zh: : 那倒是让人安心。要是店长天天追着你挑刺,我可想不了那画面。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty15
: You handle me just fine, though. And I kinda feel like your manager sometimes, you know?
lines.zh: : 可你应付我不是应付得挺好?而且我有时候觉得自己就像你的店长,你懂吗?

lines.en: : Sure, that bitch Makoto is the one always making sure you do your work and stuff-
lines.zh: : 当然,那位贱人 Makoto 才是天天盯着你干活的那个——

lines.en: : You can’t just casually call her a-
lines.zh: : 你不能张口就管她叫——

lines.en: : But I’m the one making sure you get up on time and make it to[school].
lines.zh: : 但准时叫你起床、把你塞进 [school] 的人,是我。

lines.en: : And I’m the one who gets to hold your hand and help you make all the correct decisions for things that actually matter.
lines.zh: : 而在真正重要的事情上,牵你的手、帮你做出所有正确决定的人,也是我。

lines.en: : We’ve got a special bond that no one else could ever hope to replicate! So I’m not just a manager, I’m a...super manager!
lines.zh: : 我们之间的羁绊,没有任何人复制得了!所以我不只是店长,我是……超级店长!

lines.en: : I’m sure that will look great on future job applications.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定,这行字写进未来的简历里一定很拉风。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty16
: Future applications?
lines.zh: : 未来的简历?

lines.en: : Yeah. You can’t just stay at the maid cafe forever, right?
lines.zh: : 对啊。你不会打算在女仆咖啡厅干一辈子吧?

lines.en: I mean, it’s not like she can ever really get a “real” job at this rate, though. So I guess technically she can stay here forever.
lines.zh: : 话说回来,照这个架势,她本来也永远找不到「正经」工作。所以严格来说,她确实可以在这里干一辈子。

lines.en: But still, I should at least try to push her in the right direction every once in a while.
lines.zh: 但话虽如此,我还是应该时不时把她往正确的方向推一推。

lines.en: : I wasn’t planning on staying here forever.
lines.zh: : 我没打算在这里干一辈子。

lines.en: : Well then what’s your goal once you get out of [high_school]?
lines.zh: : 那你 [high_school] 毕业以后的目标是什么?

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty17
: To wait on your every beck and call.
lines.zh: : 随传随到,任你差遣。

lines.en: : Why did I expect for even a moment that you were going to say something else?
lines.zh: : 我居然还期待了一秒你会说出别的答案,我图什么?

lines.en: if ami_virgin == False:
: I have no idea. I’ve done nothing but force myself on you from the get-go and that’s just a thing you’re going to have to deal with for the rest of forever.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。我从一开始就在对你死缠烂打,这是你余生都得习惯的事。

lines.en: else:
: I have no idea. I’ve done nothing but try to get you to notice me as more than a [niece] from the get-go and you still think you can avoid my love.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。我从一开始就在努力让你注意到——我不只是一个 [niece]——而你到现在还以为躲得开我的爱。

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: : Don’t Ami me, Mister.
lines.zh: : 别拿「Ami」糊弄我,先生。

lines.en: : I’ll be with you forever, even if you don’t want me there.
lines.zh: : 哪怕你不要我,我也会永远陪着你。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty18
: But right now, I’m Ami-chan! Third most popular maid in the entire cafe!
lines.zh: : 但现在,我是 Ami 酱!全店人气第三的女仆!

lines.en: : I’m assuming Uta is one of those two but...has Osako already overtaken you in the rankings?
lines.zh: : 我猜其中一个是 Uta……但 Osako 的人气已经超过你了?

lines.en: : Oh, no. I’m talking about someone completely different. But I’ve vowed to not speak of who number one is at the risk of losing my job.
lines.zh: : 哦不,我说的是另一个人。但为了保住工作,我发过誓不透露第一名是谁。

lines.en: : You can’t just say something that interesting and not follow up on it.
lines.zh: : 你不能说了这么有意思的事又不往下讲。

lines.en: : Sure I can!
lines.zh: : 我就可以!

lines.en: : Besides, I don’t know if she’s ever coming back anyway, so we’ll just kinda have to wait and see I guess.
lines.zh: : 再说了,反正她也不一定会回来,我们就只能……等着看了,我猜。

lines.en: : Is it someone I know at least?
lines.zh: : 至少,是我认识的人吗?

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty19
: Maybe! But do you really think I would tell you-
lines.zh: : 说不定!但你觉得我会告诉你——

lines.en: if amipatgasm == True:
: If you tell me, I’ll pat your head.
lines.zh: : 你告诉我的话,我摸摸你的头。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty20
: Wait, no! You can’t pat my head! We found out last time that weird things happen when you pat my head!
lines.zh: : 等等,不行!你不能摸我的头!上次已经证明了,一摸我的头就会发生奇怪的事!

lines.en: : If you’re going to do that again, we need to at least go home or-
lines.zh: : 你要再来一次的话,我们至少得回家,或者——

lines.en: : Are you sure? Because I’ll do it right here.
lines.zh: : 你确定?我现在就可以摸。

lines.en: : Sensei!
lines.zh: : Sensei!

lines.en: : If you really want to know, just...keep coming back!
lines.zh: : 你真想知道的话,那就……常来!

lines.en: else:
: If you tell me, I’ll pat your head.
lines.zh: : 你告诉我的话,我摸摸你的头。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty21
: Hmm...that does seem like a fair trade, but still. I can’t do it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这笔交易听起来确实公平,但还是不行。

lines.en: : You’ll just have to...keep coming back until you find out for yourself.
lines.zh: : 你只能……一直来、一直来,直到自己弄清答案。

lines.en: : Are you challenging me to come to the maid cafe every day for the rest of my life?
lines.zh: : 你这是在挑战我余生每天都来女仆咖啡厅报到?

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty22
: Perhaps I am.
lines.zh: : 或许是。

lines.en: : And yes, I know that this means you might go broke. But that’s okay!
lines.zh: : 对,我知道这意味着你可能会破产。但没关系!

lines.en: : The two of us could move into some strange abandoned building and live out the rest of our days taking donations from strangers or waiting for government assistance!
lines.zh: : 我们俩可以搬进某栋奇怪的废弃楼,靠向路人讨捐款、或者等政府救济度过余生!

lines.en: : Well I definitely don't need to know who the secret maid is that much.
lines.zh: : 那我肯定还犯不着知道那个秘密女仆是谁。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty23
: Of course you don’t, because I’m the only maid you’ll ever need anyway.
lines.zh: : 你当然犯不着,反正我这个女仆,你一辈子也用不完。

lines.en: : I will admit that I was very jealous when I found out you wanted to marry Uta-chan-
lines.zh: : 我承认,听说你想娶 Uta 酱的时候,我嫉妒疯了——

lines.en: : Want. Not wanted. The desire is still there.
lines.zh: : 是「想娶」,不是「想过」。这个欲望现在还在。

lines.en: : She will be mine.
lines.zh: : 她终将是我的。

lines.en: : Oh, yes.
lines.zh: : 哦,没错。

lines.en: : She will be mine...
lines.zh: : 她终将是我的……

lines.en: : No. Because I will be yours.
lines.zh: : 不。因为我是你的。

lines.en: : You haven’t spent as much time with me here as you have with her yet, but I’m like a walking trash receptacle for your love!
lines.zh: : 你在这里陪我的时间还没陪她多,但我就是你爱的移动垃圾桶!

lines.en: : Please be a little kinder with the things you say about yourself. You are a reflection of me and-
lines.zh: : 请你对自己说话稍微温柔一点。你是我的倒影,而——

lines.en: : Actually, yeah. That much is fine if you’re a reflection of me.
lines.zh: : 其实,也对。你要真是我的倒影,那倒也没什么问题。

lines.en: : ...As I was saying! I spent years and years and years and years turning into Mega Ami so you wouldn’t look at people like Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : ……回到正题!我花了好几年又几年又几年又几年,把自己进化成 Mega Ami,就是为了不让你去看 Uta 酱那样的人。

lines.en: : And if I find out it’s just because of her stupid boobs I’m skipping out on a new bathing suit and saving up for implants!
lines.zh: : 我要是发现这只是因为那对蠢胸,我就不买新泳衣了,改攒钱做隆胸!

lines.en: : Please don’t do that. I like you just the way you are.
lines.zh: : 求你别。我就喜欢你现在的样子。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty18
: Exactly!
lines.zh: : 这就对了!

lines.en: : So, with that out of the way, come with me to the mall and appreciate my depressingly tiny chest as I try on new bathing suits for you!
lines.zh: : 好了,话都说开了,陪我去商场吧——欣赏我那令人心酸的迷你胸口,给你试穿新泳衣!

lines.en: : No more one piece?
lines.zh: : 不穿连体款了?

lines.en: : No more one piece.
lines.zh: : 不穿连体款了。

lines.en: : Well, I’ve seen you naked before, so that’s not too drastic of a change.
lines.zh: : 呃,我看过你裸体,所以这变化也不算太劲爆。

lines.en: : Exactly! It’ll be just like me walking around the house in my underwear. Just if you get excited, everyone around you will notice and not just me!
lines.zh: : 完全正确!就跟我在家里穿内衣晃来晃去一样。唯一的区别是,你要是兴奋了,周围所有人都会看见,而不只是我!

lines.en: : I still think it’s insane you’re even considering doing something like this when it is literally snowing out.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得你疯了,外面明明在下雪,你居然在考虑这种事。

lines.en: : The snow can only last so long! And youth is not eternal!
lines.zh: : 雪总会停的!而青春不是永恒的!

lines.en: : Appreciate me while you can, Sensei. Because you never know when I’m gonna hit my growth spurt and become a sultry, sexy [niece] rather than a cute one.
lines.zh: : 趁能欣赏,赶紧欣赏我吧,Sensei。谁知道我什么时候猛蹿个头,从可爱的 [niece] 变成妖艳性感的 [niece]。

lines.en: : Doubtful. Right now, I think sultry and sexy are the two words I would literally never describe you with.
lines.zh: : 不可能。眼下,「妖艳」和「性感」是我这辈子都不会用在你身上的两个词。

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty24
: I can be sexy if I want to be! Just look at my costume!
lines.zh: : 我想要性感就能性感!看看我这身制服!

lines.en: : Again, that’s more “cute” than it is sexy.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍,那更偏「可爱」,不偏性感。

lines.en: : What do I have to wear to be sexy?!
lines.zh: : 那我要穿什么才算性感?!

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty25
: Ami, what are you freaking out about? Isn’t he your [uncle]?
lines.zh: : Ami,你抓狂什么?他不是你的 [uncle] 吗?

lines.en: : Why do you have to look-
lines.zh: : 你为什么非要——

lines.en: : Shut up, Osako-chan! Tell him I’m sexy!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴,Osako 酱!快告诉他我很性感!

lines.en: scene amimaidthirty24
: Well...maybe I’m not sexy yet! But you just wait!
lines.zh: : 哼……也许我现在还不够性感!但你等着!

lines.en: : You’ve got a long time left with me, Mister! And I’m not gonna be your little girl forever!
lines.zh: : 你还有大把时间陪着我,先生!我不会永远当你的小丫头的!

lines.en: : Well, I will always be your little girl! But I’ll eventually be a...big little girl! With boobs and...allure!
lines.zh: : 哦不对,我会永远是你的小丫头!但我总有一天会变成一个……大号小丫头!带着胸,还有……魅力!

lines.en: : And you will love me!
lines.zh: : 而你会爱我的!

lines.en: : ...Okay, I’m gonna step outside for a bit.
lines.zh: : ……好了,我要出去待一会儿。

lines.en: : Let me know if you need help or anything...
lines.zh: : 有需要帮忙的随时叫我……

lines.en: scene black
Instead of bringing me anything to eat, Ami spends the next twenty minutes lecturing me about things I should and should not say to her.
lines.zh: Ami 没有给我端来任何吃的,而是花了接下来二十分钟,给我上课:哪些话该说、哪些话不该对她说。

lines.en: Of course, Ami’s entire thing is that she’ll accept me unconditionally no matter what I do, so it goes in one ear and out the other.
lines.zh: 当然,Ami 的整个人设就是:无论我做什么,她都无条件接受我——所以这些话左耳进右耳出。

lines.en: But hey, even when she’s incessantly ranting about her inferiority complex, she still manages to be cute about it.
lines.zh: 不过嘛,哪怕她喋喋不休地控诉自己的自卑情结,她照样能可爱地完成这件事。

lines.en: Is she annoying? Sure.
lines.zh: 她烦人吗?烦。

lines.en: But she’s family.
lines.zh: 但她是家人。

lines.en: And I don’t really have a problem saying that now.
lines.zh: 而现在,我已经能没什么障碍地说出这句话了。

lines.en: It’s family’s job to be annoying, so I can’t really foresee that ever going away.
lines.zh: 家人的职责就是烦人,所以我看不出这一点会有消失的一天。

lines.en: Granted, I can’t see her ever “growing up” either but, chances are, I won’t ever have to.
lines.zh: 诚然,我也看不出她哪天会真的「长大」,但大概率,我也不用等到那一天。

lines.en: So I should just accept my [niece] in all of her current, non-sexy perpetual glory.
lines.zh: 所以我该做的,就是全盘接受我的 [niece]——连同她此刻这副与性感无缘、却永远闪光的模样。

lines.en: For she is but a trash receptacle-
lines.zh: 因为她不过是一只垃圾桶——

lines.en: And I am a man walking down the streets of a busy neighborhood, clutching an empty can and waiting for a place to toss it out.
lines.zh: 而我,是一个走在热闹街区的男人,手里攥着一只空罐,正等着一个可以丢弃它的地方。

lines.en: Also, even though I’ve seen her naked around the house before, I’m weirdly excited to see Ami try on new swimsuits.
lines.zh: 话说回来,虽然我在家里看过她裸体的次数不少,但一想到要看 Ami 试穿新泳衣,我竟然还是有点小激动。

lines.en: But if she winds up getting a cold as a result of stripping down to that much bare skin in the middle of winter, I’m having her pay for her own medical bills.
lines.zh: 不过她要是因为大冬天扒到只剩那么点布料而感冒了,医药费她自己出。

Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!
